package teacherdialog_test

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/teacherdialog"
)

func TestProgressivePedagogyStartsWithSocraticHint(t *testing.T) {
	plan, err := pedagogyRegistry(t).Plan(
		validTeacher(), validDialogRequest(), validStudentContext(), validDialogContext(), nil,
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 1, plan.HintLevel)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherGuidanceSocraticQuestion, plan.Guidance)
	require.Equal(t, domain.DefaultPedagogyMethodCode, plan.MethodCode)
	require.Equal(t, domain.ProgressiveHintMethodVersion, plan.MethodVersion)
	require.Equal(t, domain.AMCDOrient, plan.Stage)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherActionGiveHint, plan.Action)
	require.False(t, plan.AllowCompleteSolution)
}

func TestProgressivePedagogyAnswersGeneralDialogWithoutHintEscalation(t *testing.T) {
	request := validDialogRequest()
	request.ContextType = domain.LearningContextGeneral
	request.ContextID = ""
	request.LearningActionID = ""
	student := domain.StudentContext{StudentID: request.StudentID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral}
	dialog := validDialogContext()
	dialog.ContextType = domain.LearningContextGeneral
	dialog.ContextID = ""
	dialog.LearningActionID = ""
	dialog.Messages[0].LearningActionID = ""

	plan, err := pedagogyRegistry(t).Plan(validTeacher(), request, student, dialog, nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherActionRespond, plan.Action)
	require.Equal(t, 0, plan.HintLevel)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherGuidanceAdaptiveExplanation, plan.Guidance)
	require.False(t, plan.AllowCompleteSolution)
}

func TestProgressivePedagogyUsesExplicitLessonModeWithoutHintEscalation(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		mode       domain.LessonMessageMode
		selection  string
		reasonCode string
	}{
		{mode: domain.LessonMessageModeOverview, reasonCode: "verified_lesson_overview"},
		{mode: domain.LessonMessageModeSelection, selection: "фрагмент", reasonCode: "verified_lesson_selection"},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(string(tt.mode), func(t *testing.T) {
			request := validDialogRequest()
			request.ContextType = domain.LearningContextLesson
			request.LearningActionID = ""
			student := domain.StudentContext{
				StudentID: request.StudentID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextLesson, ContextID: request.ContextID,
			}
			dialog := validDialogContext()
			dialog.ContextType = domain.LearningContextLesson
			dialog.LearningActionID = ""
			dialog.Messages[0].LearningActionID = ""
			dialog.Messages[0].LessonContext = &domain.LessonMessageContext{
				Schema: domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion, Mode: tt.mode,
				CourseID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", LessonID: request.ContextID,
				ContentRevision: "2026-08-31T09:00:00Z", SelectedText: tt.selection,
			}

			plan, err := pedagogyRegistry(t).Plan(validTeacher(), request, student, dialog, nil)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherActionRespond, plan.Action)
			require.Zero(t, plan.HintLevel)
			require.Equal(t, tt.reasonCode, plan.ReasonCode)
			require.False(t, plan.AllowCompleteSolution)
		})
	}
}

func TestProgressivePedagogyEscalatesOneLevelAndCapsAtSeven(t *testing.T) {
	levelSix := 6
	plan, err := pedagogyRegistry(t).Plan(
		validTeacher(), validDialogRequest(), validStudentContext(), validDialogContext(),
		[]domain.TeacherDecision{{
			StudentID: validDialogRequest().StudentID, LearningActionID: validDialogRequest().LearningActionID,
			Action: domain.TeacherActionGiveHint, HintLevel: &levelSix,
		}},
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 7, plan.HintLevel)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherGuidanceGuidedBreakdown, plan.Guidance)

	levelSeven := 7
	plan, err = pedagogyRegistry(t).Plan(
		validTeacher(), validDialogRequest(), validStudentContext(), validDialogContext(),
		[]domain.TeacherDecision{{
			StudentID: validDialogRequest().StudentID, LearningActionID: validDialogRequest().LearningActionID,
			Action: domain.TeacherActionGiveHint, HintLevel: &levelSeven,
		}},
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 7, plan.HintLevel)
}

func TestProgressivePedagogyCannotExceedPracticeAssistancePolicy(t *testing.T) {
	student := validStudentContext()
	student.PracticeTask = &domain.PracticeTaskContext{AssistancePolicy: domain.PracticeTaskAssistancePolicy{Version: 1, MaxHintLevel: 2}}
	levelTwo := 2
	plan, err := pedagogyRegistry(t).Plan(
		validTeacher(), validDialogRequest(), student, validDialogContext(),
		[]domain.TeacherDecision{{
			StudentID: validDialogRequest().StudentID, LearningActionID: validDialogRequest().LearningActionID,
			Action: domain.TeacherActionGiveHint, HintLevel: &levelTwo,
		}},
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 2, plan.HintLevel)
	require.Equal(t, "practice_policy_bounded_hint", plan.ReasonCode)
	require.False(t, plan.AllowCompleteSolution)
}

func TestProgressivePedagogyUsesQuestionWhenPracticeForbidsHintsAndExplanations(t *testing.T) {
	student := validStudentContext()
	student.PracticeTask = &domain.PracticeTaskContext{AssistancePolicy: domain.PracticeTaskAssistancePolicy{Version: 1, MaxHintLevel: 0}}
	plan, err := pedagogyRegistry(t).Plan(validTeacher(), validDialogRequest(), student, validDialogContext(), nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherActionAskQuestion, plan.Action)
	require.Zero(t, plan.HintLevel)
	require.Equal(t, "practice_assistance_policy", plan.ReasonCode)
}

func TestProgressivePedagogyUsesSafeFallbackForUnknownConfiguredPolicy(t *testing.T) {
	teacher := validTeacher()
	teacher.HintPolicy = "future-policy"
	plan, err := pedagogyRegistry(t).Plan(
		teacher, validDialogRequest(), validStudentContext(), validDialogContext(), nil,
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "safe_progressive_fallback", plan.ReasonCode)
	require.False(t, plan.AllowCompleteSolution)
}

type replacementMethod struct{}

func (replacementMethod) Code() string    { return "experimental" }
func (replacementMethod) Version() string { return "experimental-v1" }
func (replacementMethod) Plan(input teacherdialog.PedagogyMethodInput) (domain.TeacherTeachingPlan, error) {
	return domain.NewTeacherTeachingPlan(domain.TeacherTeachingPlan{
		PolicyVersion: domain.TeacherDialogPolicyVersion,
		MethodCode:    "experimental", MethodVersion: "experimental-v1",
		TeachingMode: domain.TeachingModePractice, Strategy: "retrieval_practice",
		Stage: "recall", Action: domain.TeacherActionGiveHint, HintLevel: 1,
		Guidance: domain.TeacherGuidanceConceptReminder, ReasonCode: "experimental_method",
		ReasonSummary: "Selected by the registered experimental method.",
	})
}

func TestPedagogyRegistryAddsAndSelectsMethodWithoutOrchestratorChanges(t *testing.T) {
	registry, err := teacherdialog.NewPedagogyRegistry(
		domain.DefaultPedagogyMethodCode, teacherdialog.ProgressiveHintMethod{}, replacementMethod{},
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	teacher := validTeacher()
	teacher.PedagogyProfile = "experimental"
	plan, err := registry.Plan(
		teacher, validDialogRequest(), validStudentContext(), validDialogContext(), nil,
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "experimental", plan.MethodCode)
	require.Equal(t, domain.PedagogyStage("recall"), plan.Stage)
}

func TestPedagogyRegistryFallsBackSafelyWhenConfiguredMethodIsUnavailable(t *testing.T) {
	teacher := validTeacher()
	teacher.PedagogyProfile = "removed-method"
	plan, err := pedagogyRegistry(t).Plan(
		teacher, validDialogRequest(), validStudentContext(), validDialogContext(), nil,
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.DefaultPedagogyMethodCode, plan.MethodCode)
	require.Equal(t, "safe_progressive_fallback", plan.ReasonCode)
}

func TestPedagogyRegistryRejectsDuplicateMethodCodes(t *testing.T) {
	_, err := teacherdialog.NewPedagogyRegistry(
		domain.DefaultPedagogyMethodCode,
		teacherdialog.ProgressiveHintMethod{}, teacherdialog.ProgressiveHintMethod{},
	)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "duplicate")
}

func pedagogyRegistry(t *testing.T) teacherdialog.PedagogyRegistry {
	t.Helper()
	registry, err := teacherdialog.NewPedagogyRegistry(
		domain.DefaultPedagogyMethodCode, teacherdialog.ProgressiveHintMethod{},
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return registry
}

func validTeacher() domain.PersonalTeacher {
	return domain.PersonalTeacher{
		ID: validDialogRequest().PersonalTeacherID, StudentID: validDialogRequest().StudentID,
		TeacherProfileID: "default", Language: "ru", CommunicationStyle: "adaptive",
		PedagogyProfile: "adaptive", HintPolicy: "progressive", InterventionMode: "balanced", Version: 1,
	}
}

func validStudentContext() domain.StudentContext {
	request := validDialogRequest()
	return domain.StudentContext{
		StudentID: request.StudentID, LearningActionID: request.LearningActionID,
		TaskID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", ContextType: request.ContextType,
		ContextID: request.ContextID,
	}
}

func validDialogContext() domain.DialogRequestContext {
	request := validDialogRequest()
	return domain.DialogRequestContext{
		DialogID: request.DialogID, StudentID: request.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: request.PersonalTeacherID,
		ContextType: request.ContextType, ContextID: request.ContextID, SourceMessageID: request.SourceMessageID,
		LearningActionID: request.LearningActionID,
		Messages: []domain.DialogMessage{{
			ID: request.SourceMessageID, DialogID: request.DialogID, AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorUser, Channel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb,
			SenderID: request.StudentID, LearningActionID: request.LearningActionID, Body: "Почему тест падает?",
			Status: 1, MessageSequence: request.SourceSequence, LastEventSequence: request.EventSequence,
			CreatedAt: request.OccurredAt,
		}},
	}
}
